title: Storm Burst Totem Hierophant
overview:
Level with fire spells, then place Storm Burst totems. Choose among Atlas, damage and defensive mana-based setups.

Build reference by Blux. Original guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rt4U8KAQ4PQ
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/rChqksfom9mV

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Campaign · Fire spells
stages.goal: Level with Rolling Magma and fire utility. The Skills set contains links for different acts.
stages.priority: Save a copy of Storm Burst and Spell Totem to level for the swap.

stages.title: Transition · First totems
stages.goal: Switch to Storm Burst Totems when you can equip the socket setup.
stages.priority: Add a source of mana recovery and keep resists capped.

stages.title: Atlas · Day-one setup
stages.goal: Place totems to deal damage while you move.
stages.priority: Follow the early shield and mana gear setup.

stages.title: Endgame · Tankier option
stages.priority: Keep the main damage setup and assemble recovery and mitigation together.

stages.title: Endgame · Bossing
stages.goal: Use the bossing gem and equipment set.
stages.priority: Check the configuration before assuming effects such as shock are active.

stages.title: Endgame · Mapping
stages.priority: Keep totem placement and movement smooth.
